lines.zh: 我贴着沙面滑过去，没声音。
lines.en: I glide over the sand without a sound.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土上，我的花纹最不显眼。
lines.en: On red badlands clay my pattern disappears.

lines.zh: 我走一条弯线，不走直线。
lines.en: I take a winding line, never straight.

lines.zh: 沙子烫，我挑石块下面走。
lines.en: The sand is hot; I keep to the shade of stones.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在身后，一路留下痕迹。
lines.en: My tail drags behind, leaving a trail.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕过去，不惊动那只鸟。
lines.en: I circle wide so that bird isn't startled.

lines.zh: 我停下来，舌头先探一探风。
lines.en: I stop and let my tongue test the wind.

lines.zh: 这段路石头多，我贴着走。
lines.en: This stretch is stony; I hug the ground.

lines.zh: 我身后那串波纹，一看就知道是我。
lines.en: That rippled trail behind me is unmistakable.

lines.zh: 沙丘背面凉，我往那边挪。
lines.en: The dune's far side is cooler; I move there.

lines.zh: 前面是走鹃的地盘，我绕着走。
lines.en: That's roadrunner country ahead; I go around.

lines.zh: 我藏在草丛边，慢慢往前。
lines.en: I hide by the grass and inch forward.

lines.zh: 一步一停，我在量这片地。
lines.en: A step, a pause — I'm measuring this ground.

lines.zh: 沙子从鳞片间滑过，我不在意。
lines.en: Sand slides between my scales; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我从一块暖石滑到另一块。
lines.en: I slide from one warm stone to another.

lines.zh: 阴影斜过来，我往那边靠。
lines.en: The shade leans in. I lean with it.
Who piled stones in my path?

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一响，你最好停。
lines.en: When my tail rattles, stop.
My tail is rattling. Back off.
Sand's hot; I follow the shade.
One shake of my rattle and the desert knows.
I only move once the sun drops.
This old skin won't shed; annoying.
My rattle sounds, and you should back off.
One patrol along the rock cracks.
Hear that rustle on the sand?
Sand works into my scales.
Go around that puddle; I don't swim.

lines.zh: 我盘着身子，等太阳挪位置。
lines.en: I coil and wait for the sun to shift.

lines.zh: 尾环轻轻一响，就够警告了。
lines.en: One soft rattle is warning enough.

lines.zh: 我在石头上摊开，晒够了再动。
lines.en: I spread on the stone till I'm warm enough.

lines.zh: 有只甲虫爬过去，我懒得理。
lines.en: A beetle crawls past; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 谁在远处走，我听得出来。
lines.en: I can tell from the sound who walks far off.

lines.zh: 舌头一伸一缩，风就清楚了。
lines.en: Tongue out and in, and the wind is clear.

lines.zh: 我的花纹和沙丘的影子一样。
lines.en: My pattern matches the dune shadows.

lines.zh: 我数着走鹃的步子，还远。
lines.en: I count the roadrunner's steps — still far.
I dug this hollow; don't step in it.
My rattle has dried; it sounds sharper now.

lines.zh: 我不叫，响环就是我的话。
lines.en: I don't call; the rattle is my voice.

lines.zh: 恶地的风一阵一阵，我等着。
lines.en: The badlands wind comes in gusts; I wait.
Another scale is lifting.
Just bask like this.

lines.zh: 风里有一股热乎的味道。
lines.en: There is a warm scent on the wind.
The sand bulged just now.
Coiled so long I forgot what I waited for.
My rattle hisses on the sand.
Wait for cool air, wait for footsteps.
This rock is warmed just right.
Did I coil on the wrong rock?
When my rattle sounds, back off.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太重，我一早听见。
lines.en: Your steps are heavy; I heard them early.
Stop — not half a step further.

lines.zh: 你听见尾环了吗？那就够了。
lines.en: You hear the rattle? Then that's enough.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，是在量你的距离。
lines.en: I raise my head to measure your distance.
If you don't back off, I stop warning.

lines.zh: 别用棍子挑我，我会记仇。
lines.en: Don't poke me with a stick; I hold grudges.
My eyes don't blink; yours do.

lines.zh: 你站在我的晒太阳的地盘上。
lines.en: You're standing on my sunning ground.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就当你要踩我。
lines.en: One step more and I'll think you mean to tread on me.

lines.zh: 你身上有肉味，我闻到了。
lines.en: You smell of meat; I noticed.
Only one set of prints on this sand.
Rattlesnake? Doesn't look like one.
Looking for water? Not in this sand.
Listen to the rattle in my tail.
One rattle and the sand goes quiet.
Your boots won't stop these fangs.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底压扁我的沙窝。
lines.en: You stepped on my sand hollow.
Hold the torch higher, I can't see.
I've been buried in the sand a long while.

lines.zh: 别装没看见我盘在石头上。
lines.en: Don't pretend you missed me coiled on the rock.

lines.zh: 我盘紧了，尾环响个不停。
lines.en: I coil tight, rattle going without pause.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我晒太阳。
lines.en: That cut short my sunbathing.
Two scales flipped up — that hurts.
I warned you before you struck.

lines.zh: 我退到石头缝里，不再出来。
lines.en: I retreat into a rock crack and stay.

lines.zh: 毒牙还完好，这算好消息。
lines.en: The fangs are intact — that's the good news.

lines.zh: 我尾巴抬起来了，你最好退。
lines.en: My tail is up; you'd best back off.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起了走鹃。
lines.en: That blow reminded me of the roadrunner.
I don't cry out; snakes don't.

lines.zh: 沙里藏不住疼，我只能忍。
lines.en: Sand can't hide pain; I just endure it.
Pain makes my rattle buzz.

lines.zh: 毒囊还满着，可骨头裂了。
lines.en: Venom sac full, but my bones cracked.
Again — my scales are tough.

lines.zh: 毒牙还在，只是身子僵了。
lines.en: The fangs are fine — only my body's stiff.
My rattle is going; you angered me.

lines.zh: 你的棍子正打在我的环纹上。
lines.en: Your stick landed right on my bands.
The badlands stone is hotter than I am.
I can still lift myself up.
Who threw a stone into my sand?
Back off, my fangs are already bared.

lines.zh: 肉味是真的，我不挑种类。
lines.en: That meat smell is real; I'm not picky.
Put the meat down and back off three steps.
I'll come over slowly; don't reach out.
Raw meat is best; cooked will do.

lines.zh: 为了这块肉，尾环先收起来。
lines.en: For this meat, the rattle goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，但我还要再看一会儿。
lines.en: I smell it, but I'll watch a while longer.

lines.zh: 你晃那块肉，我头就跟着动。
lines.en: Wave that meat and my head follows.
Breeding first requires meat.
Stronger than a desert rat, this smell.

lines.zh: 别扔过来，我讨厌突然的动静。
lines.en: Don't toss it; sudden moves annoy me.
Set it down, back off, I won't follow.
That smell in the sand — meat.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在响，你听见了。
lines.en: My tail is rattling — you hear it.
I only want the one that moves.

lines.zh: 那点热气，我的舌头尝到了。
lines.en: My tongue tastes that warmth.
Is it warm or cold?
Don't sway, I can't aim my strike.
I swallow it whole, no need to cut.
An egg will do; I'm not picky.
Badland stones are just hot enough.

lines.zh: 你的脚压住了我的尾环。
lines.en: Your foot is pinning my rattle.
Before you bump me, hear the rattle.
I coiled too close to the path.

lines.zh: 这一脚让我整条身子都绷紧了。
lines.en: That kick tensed my whole body.
Don't test me with your boot; I bite.
I'll move aside, unwillingly.

lines.zh: 沙被踢起来，落了我一身。
lines.en: Kicked sand settles all over me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，你还站着不动。
lines.en: I look up at you and you still don't move.

lines.zh: 该退的是你，我盘在这儿。
lines.en: You're the one to retreat; I'm coiled here.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚边滑过去，别动。
lines.en: I'll slide past your foot — hold still.
A bump will not kill you; my venom will.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一响，你就退了。
lines.en: My rattle sounds and you step back.
Don't crowd me, I'm coiled.
Watch your step, I lie flat on the sand.
One rattle of my tail is the warning.
You stepped on the sand I'm coiled on.
You scuffed my scales loose.

lines.zh: 站稳，你的脚跟压着我的尾尖。
lines.en: Steady, don't step on my tail.

lines.zh: 两块石头之间，刚好夹住我。
lines.en: Between two stones, I barely fit.
You kicked my rattle.
Your rattle sounds deeper than mine.

lines.zh: 我们盘在一处，晒同一块石头。
lines.en: Coiled together, we share one warm stone.
Half the meat is yours — don't snatch.
When the roadrunner comes, we split ways.

lines.zh: 沙窝挖好了，就在那块石头下。
lines.en: The nest hollow is dug, under that stone.

lines.zh: 孩子生下来就会响环吗？
lines.en: Will the young rattle from birth?

lines.zh: 你靠过来一点，沙子挡风。
lines.en: Come closer; the sand blocks the wind.
Don't let other snakes into this patch.
It's cold; let's coil tighter.

lines.zh: 明年这时候，还在这道沙梁。
lines.en: Same sand ridge this time next year.
The sand hollow is warm, come along.
Our rattles sound alike.
Coiled, my rattle still sounds.
I've waited here three nights.
The hollow I cleared is wide enough.

lines.zh: 沙漠里，只有我们两条命。
lines.en: In the desert, only two lives are left.
I'll hold the venom back.
The sand burns. I follow the shade.
The rock crevice is warm; follow me.
One shake of my rattle and the sand rings.

lines.zh: 这块肉掉在地上，归我了。
lines.en: This meat fell on the ground — mine.
I swallow it whole, no chewing.
That bone is too big to swallow.

lines.zh: 有只沙鼠倒在沙里，正好。
lines.en: A desert rat lies dead in the sand — just right.
I don't pick up shiny things, only meat.

lines.zh: 吞完我找个石头底下消化。
lines.en: After swallowing I'll digest under a stone.

lines.zh: 这味道不新鲜，但还能吃。
lines.en: Not fresh, but still edible.
The scrap you dropped — I'll take it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张嘴，把它整个吞了。
lines.en: I open slowly and take it whole.
After this meal I won't move for days.
I'll coil around this and keep it.

lines.zh: 这块铁，正好压住我的窝。
lines.en: This iron will pin my den down.
Don't watch me swallow.

lines.zh: 尾巴上的响环，就是警告。
lines.en: The rattle on my tail is the warning.
Can I swallow something this hard?

lines.zh: 恶地的石头下面，我盘着。
lines.en: Under badlands stone, I coil.
Don't grab it, that egg is mine.
Coiled on a warm stone, I do not want to move.

lines.zh: 沙漠的热把我烤得很干。
lines.en: Desert heat dries me out.
Heavy, but it counts as a find.
Something moves under the sand over there.
A desert rat — I'm fixed on it.

lines.zh: 走鹃的影子落下来，我看见了。
lines.en: A roadrunner's shadow falls; I see it.

lines.zh: 有脚步声，不太重，是猎物。
lines.en: Footsteps, not heavy — prey.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，锁住那个方向。
lines.en: I raise my head and lock onto that direction.

lines.zh: 舌头顶到气味，就在前面。
lines.en: My tongue catches the scent — just ahead.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，花纹起作用了。
lines.en: It hasn't seen me; the pattern works.

lines.zh: 我慢慢拉直身子，准备弹出去。
lines.en: I straighten out slowly, ready to lunge.

lines.zh: 目标在石头背面，我绕过去。
lines.en: The target's behind a stone; I circle it.

lines.zh: 那团影子太小，不是猎物。
lines.en: That shadow is too small to be prey.

lines.zh: 我先响一声，看它动不动。
lines.en: I rattle once and see if it moves.
Close enough — I stop waiting.
You stepped into my sand hollow.
You, don't hide behind that rock.
I've got the crevice covered.

lines.zh: 尾环摇起来，你应该听得见。
lines.en: My tail rings rattle — you should hear them.
Your heartbeat carries through the sand.
My tail rattles. Time to back off.
My fangs have just regrown.
My tail rattles as a warning.
Your sweat is strong.
My tail shakes. Rattle, rattle.
Don't shout; sand carries sound.
One shake of my rattle and the sand hisses.
The sand is hot; my rattle sounds first.
Finally, something warm.
I'll circle behind the dune.
Coming for me? Even better.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有舌头在动。
lines.en: I stay still; only my tongue moves.

lines.zh: 它再走两步就进范围了。
lines.en: Two more steps and it's in range.
I lower my head and draw my tail in.
Wrong wind; I'll wait a little.
It looks up; I freeze.

lines.zh: 就这一下，我瞄准了脖子。
lines.en: Just one strike — I aim for the neck.
The sand is loose; I steady myself first.

lines.zh: 我把心跳压得很慢，它听不见。
lines.en: I slow my heartbeat so it can't be heard.
Closer now, and the rattle falls silent.
It turned — the moment is right.

lines.zh: 我数到三，身子就弹出去。
lines.en: On three my body springs out.

lines.zh: 这一口要准，不能浪费毒。
lines.en: One precise bite — I won't waste venom.
Walk slow; I have patience.
Under the sand I arrive first.
Coiled under badland stone.

lines.zh: 热沙上，我的身子贴着走。
lines.en: On hot sand I move with my belly down.

lines.zh: 沙上的印子，一路都是你的。
lines.en: Every print in the sand is yours.

lines.zh: 沙上的热，把你的味道送上来。
lines.en: Heat off the sand lifts your scent to me.
One tail shake, and the sand hisses.

lines.zh: 爬石头也没用，我缠得紧。
lines.en: Climbing won't help; I coil tight.
Your body heat is getting closer.

lines.zh: 沙子把你的脚步漏给我了。
lines.en: The sand leaked your footsteps to me.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一响，你该停下来了。
lines.en: My rattle sounds; you should stop.
On the sand my tail rattles.
I don't blink and I don't sleep.

lines.zh: 拐弯？我贴着沙地抄近路。
lines.en: Turn away? I cut close along the sand.
I know every turn of these dunes.
Your prints show clear in the sand.
Wait, I don't crawl fast.
There's no one else in this sand.

lines.zh: 我盘起来，尾巴举高给你看。
lines.en: I coil up and raise my rattle for you to see.
How many more steps can you run?
The fangs land first; the warning comes after.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近了，这就是后果。
lines.en: You came too close — this is the result.

lines.zh: 一口就够，我从不咬第二次。
lines.en: One bite suffices; I never strike twice.
My venom makes your legs go weak.

lines.zh: 咬完我立刻松开，退到石头下。
lines.en: I let go at once and retreat under a stone.

lines.zh: 你踩我的那一脚，我还回来了。
lines.en: That step on me — I've returned it.
The rattle sounded three times; you didn't listen.

lines.zh: 我的牙很短，但扎得进去。
lines.en: My fangs are short, but they go in deep.

lines.zh: 别抓我尾巴，那是我的警报。
lines.en: Don't grab my tail — that's my alarm.
I leave after the strike; I don't linger.
Your legs are getting heavy, right?
Don't blink — watch my fangs.
Short fangs, but they reach you.
Iron plates don't stop venom.
Take a venomous bite!
Sorry, the fangs don't retract.
The venom is already in.
One more dose of venom.
One rattle, and my fangs are already there.
The roadrunner's back. It hunts me.

lines.zh: 沙漠的沙子，替我藏住身子。
lines.en: Desert sand hides my body.
My fangs close and you go numb.
One bite of venom, and you slow down.
My fangs move before my rattle.

lines.zh: 这一咬我练了整个夏天。
lines.en: I practiced this strike all summer.
Struck; I pull back and wait.
One bite of my fangs and you go numb.
Scream if it hurts, I can hear you.
Backing off won't help; I'm slow but steady.
Hold still, it's quick.

lines.zh: 我从沙里出来，尾环先响。
lines.en: I come out of the sand, rattle sounding first.

lines.zh: 这片恶地够热，我住下了。
lines.en: These badlands are hot enough; I'll stay.
First, a stone to sun myself on.

lines.zh: 我盘起来，看看今天有什么。
lines.en: I coil up and see what today brings.
A burrow under the sand — good cover.
No roadrunner scent in this stretch.

lines.zh: 我的花纹在红土上刚好。
lines.en: My pattern fits the red clay exactly.
I slip along the ground into the grass.
Plenty of rats here; I'll stay a while.

lines.zh: 尾环一动，四周就安静了。
lines.en: One rattle and everything around goes quiet.
Who's moving beyond the dune?

lines.zh: 这块沙窝我要多待几天。
lines.en: I'll keep this hollow for a few days.
I poke my head up through the sand.
Listen, my rattle is going.
This rock has baked too hot.
I wake between the dunes.
the dark. I've arrived.
The sand sways; I can't coil steady.
Out of the sand and already hungry.
The sand is cool. Good for waking up.
Who brushed the sand off me?
I raise myself to look around.

lines.zh: 鳞片一烤就卷，别拿火近我。
lines.en: My scales curl in heat — keep flames away.

lines.zh: 尾巴的响环都在烧，快灭掉。
lines.en: Even my rattle is burning, put it out.

lines.zh: 从石头上摔下来，身子打了结。
lines.en: I fell off the rock and my body knotted.

lines.zh: 从石头上滑下来，摔疼了。
lines.en: I slid off the rock and landed hard.

lines.zh: 水一漫过背，我就使不上劲。
lines.en: Water over my back and I have no strength.
The sand soaks up water; I'm sinking.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀到沙丘那头。
lines.en: The blast flung me to the far dune.
The blast rolled me over.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的尾环。
lines.en: An arrow went through my rattle.
My fangs never landed — the arrow did.

lines.zh: 咒语让我的舌头尝不出味道。
lines.en: The spell left my tongue tasteless.
Those words make my scales burn.
Seven days without meat and my fangs dull.

lines.zh: 沙漠里再不吃就撑不住。
lines.en: In the desert, fasting too long ends me.

lines.zh: 雷落后，沙地烫得像铁板。
lines.en: After the lightning the sand burns like iron.
Lightning on the sand, blinding bright.

lines.zh: 我盘在空中，找不到落点。
lines.en: I coil in midair with nowhere to land.

lines.zh: 连沙粒落下的声音都没有。
lines.en: Not even a grain of sand falls here.
